in_marathi.name: Ratikanta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of the night
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ratikanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ratikanta is a Sanskrit name which means 'Ruler of the night'. This name is derived from the Hindu god Ratri, the goddess of the night. The name is bestowed upon a child who is believed to have the qualities of a ruler, such as strength, courage, and loyalty.
